lanes.summary: The diff correctly implements the requested changes for GH-4143. It adds the check for `_path` in `resolve()` to prevent relative paths from resolving against `cwd` when no verdict location is present, returning the explicit refusal reason. It also updates `coherent()` to accurately report any refusal reason by name (except "no receipt recorded", which retains its existing generic behavior) for both ladder and lane checks. The tests and mutants in `nightly_admission_cases.py` exactly match the claims made in the receipt. No refutations were found.

The diff for GH-4143 fulfills all ticket requirements and receipt claims without refutation:
1. Defect Fix: `nightly_admission.resolve()` refuses relative receipt paths when a verdict has no `_path`, returning `(None, "a relative receipt path %r with no verdict location" % p)` instead of falling back to cwd (`os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(""))`).
2. Error Reporting: `coherent()` now surfaces any resolve refusal by name (`if lad_p is None and why and why != "no receipt recorded":`) rather than falling through to generic "unreadable" or "missing or not PASS".
3. Test Coverage & Mutants: `scripts/lib/nightly_admission_cases.py` introduces test row `relative-path-without-verdict-location-refused`, executing inside a cwd with valid GREEN receipts at the relative path to ensure only the missing verdict location check triggers refusal. All 20 rows pass and 15/15 mutants are killed, including `no-path-from-cwd` and updated `escape-followed-ladder`.
4. Gates and Verification: `check_certify_nightly.sh` passes completely. No gates are weakened, no tests assert contradictory behavior, receipt claims are fully backed by measurements, and no out-of-scope changes are present.

findings.claim: `nightly_admission.resolve()` checks `if not v.get("_path"):` and returns `(None, "a relative receipt path %r with no verdict location" % p)` when a relative path is passed for a verdict lacking `_path`, eliminating fallback to cwd.

`coherent()` reports resolve refusals by name (`if lad_p is None and why and why != "no receipt recorded":` and CRUX equivalent) instead of masking them behind generic "unreadable" or "missing or not PASS" messages.

`nightly_admission_cases.py` runs row `relative-path-without-verdict-location-refused` where cwd is set to `moved` (which contains valid GREEN receipts at that relative path) to verify that only the missing `_path` rule refuses it. All 20 rows PASS and 15/15 mutants are killed.
Mutant `no-path-from-cwd` mutates `if not v.get("_path"):` to `if False:` in `nightly_admission.py` and is proven killed by row `relative-path-without-verdict-location-refused`.
`bash scripts/check_certify_nightly.sh` runs cleanly, passing all driver table rows and killing all mutants, exiting 0 with PASS.
Receipt `docs/audits/impl-GH-4143-receipt.md` accurately documents the defect, changes, and verification measurements backed by the diff.
